name: multicam-video-preprocessing
description: Universal multi-camera video processing pipeline and AI editing suite for 2 to 6 cameras. Features MFCC acoustic time alignment with subframe refinement (<0.125ms), EBU R128 loudness normalization (-14 LUFS), multi-in-one compact grid composition, Gemini 3.8 Flash Agentic Video zero-split full pipeline, deterministic 8-check EDL semantic validation with strict gate safeguard, FCP7 XML timeline export, and single-pass hardware video rendering.
